## English translation

### Secret codes for “Robin Hood”

By **BROLY5783**

Cheats for the game Robin Hood.

### CHEAT LIST

Hello everyone, I bring you the list of “cheats” published by FX Interactive in Spain for the video game Robin Hood.

> **Dear Robin,**<br>
> I entrust you with the secret codes of Sherwood Forest: they will help you rescue Lady Marian, defeat the Sheriff of Nottingham, and reclaim the throne of Richard the Lionheart.

### HOW TO ACTIVATE THE SECRET CODES

- During the game, select a character who is standing, place the cursor over the “Crouch” command, and press **F11**: the game scene disappears and is replaced by a black screen.
- Enter the secret-code text you want and then press **Enter** to activate it.

| Code | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `cash` | Increases your money by 1,000 gold coins. |
| `goodluck` | Gives you 100 new clovers. |
| `bingo` | Gives you 999 units of each of your items. |
| `merryman` | Recruits a new companion in Sherwood Forest. |
| `pam` | Enemies stop being intelligent. |
| `unblip` | Reveals the position of all enemies on the map. |
| `immunity` | Makes you invincible. |
| `winner` | Grants you victory in the current mission. |

[Cheats in PDF format](https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.fxinteractive.com%2Fp234%2Fimages%2F234codigos_secretos.pdf) ([www.fxinteractive.com](http://www.fxinteractive.com)).

Cheats published by [FX Interactive](https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fweb.fxinteractive.com%2F) ([web.fxinteractive.com](https://web.fxinteractive.com/)).

## Original text

### CODIGOS SECRETOS PARA “ROBIN HOOD”

Por **BROLY5783**

Trucos para el juego Robin Hood.

### LISTA DE TRUCOS

Hola a todo el mundo, os traigo la lista de “trucos” que publicó la empresa FX Interactive en España, para el videojuego Robin Hood.

> _Estimado Robin,_<br>
> _Te confío los códigos secretos del Bosque de Sherwood: te ayudarán a rescatar a Lady Marian, derrotar al Sheriff de Nottingham y recuperar el trono de Ricardo Corazón de León._

### CÓMO ACTIVAR LOS CÓDIGOS SECRETOS

- Durante la partida, selecciona un personaje que se encuentre de pie, sitúa el cursor sobre la orden ‘Agacharse’ y pulsa la tecla **F11**: el escenario del juego desaparece para dar paso a una pantalla en negro.
- Introduce el texto del código secreto que quieras y, a continuación, pulsa la tecla **Intro** para activarlo.

| Código | Efecto |
| --- | --- |
| `cash` | Incrementa tu dinero en 1.000 monedas de oro. |
| `goodluck` | Te concede 100 nuevos tréboles. |
| `bingo` | Te da 999 unidades de cada uno de tus objetos. |
| `merryman` | Recluta un nuevo compañero en el Bosque de Sherwood. |
| `pam` | Los enemigos dejan de ser inteligentes. |
| `unblip` | Revela la posición de todos los enemigos del mapa. |
| `immunity` | Te convierte en invencible. |
| `winner` | Te concede la victoria en la misión en curso. |

[Trucos en formato PDF](https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.fxinteractive.com%2Fp234%2Fimages%2F234codigos_secretos.pdf) ([www.fxinteractive.com](http://www.fxinteractive.com)).

Trucos publicados por la empresa [FX Interactive](https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fweb.fxinteractive.com%2F) ([web.fxinteractive.com](https://web.fxinteractive.com/)).
